gold_sql:
WITH origin AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-74.547655 40.363996)',4326) AS pt
),
patch AS (
  SELECT ST_Buffer(pt::geography, 100)::geometry AS g FROM origin
),
clipped_dem AS (
  SELECT ST_Union(ST_Clip(d.rast, p.g)) AS rast
  FROM public.dem_us d
  JOIN patch p ON ST_Intersects(d.rast, p.g)
),
aspect_rast AS (
  SELECT ST_Aspect(rast, 1, '32BF', 'DEGREES') AS rast
  FROM clipped_dem
)
SELECT ST_Value(a.rast, 1, o.pt) AS aspect_degrees
FROM aspect_rast a, origin o;

  FROM clipped_dem

  FROM clipped_dem
)
, stats AS (
  SELECT
    ST_Stats(aspect_rast, 1, true) AS aspect_stats
  FROM aspect_raster
)
SELECT
  aspect_stats.mean AS mean_aspect_degrees
FROM stats;
